situations.title: 항응고제 종류 확인
situations.tagline: I take a blood thinner every morning, but I couldn't tell you the exact name.
situations.brief: 환자가 복용 중인 항응고제 종류를 정확히 파악하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you tell me the name of the blood thinner you take?
Do you have the pill bottle or a medication list with you?
Is it a daily pill, or something you take now and then?
goals: 복용 중인 항응고제 이름과 종류를 확인한다
확인한 정보를 기록으로 정리한다

situations.title: 마지막 복용 시각 확인
situations.tagline: I think I took my last dose yesterday morning, but I'm not totally sure.
situations.brief: 항응고제의 최종 복용 시각을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: When did you take your last dose?
Was that this morning, or yesterday?
Let me write down the exact time you remember.
goals: 마지막 복용 날짜와 시각을 구체적으로 확인한다
불확실하면 다른 단서로 시각을 좁힌다

situations.title: 경구 혈당약 중단 확인
situations.tagline: The office told me to skip my diabetes pills this morning — did I do that right?
situations.brief: 수술 당일 경구 혈당약을 중단했는지 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Did you take any of your diabetes pills this morning?
The plan was to hold them today — is that what you did?
You did the right thing by skipping them.
goals: 당일 경구 혈당약 복용 여부를 확인한다
올바른 중단이면 안심시키고 기록한다

situations.title: 수술일 인슐린 조정
situations.tagline: How much insulin was I supposed to take this morning before surgery?
situations.brief: 수술 당일 아침 인슐린 용량을 어떻게 조정했는지 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: How much insulin did you take this morning?
Did you take your usual dose, or a smaller one?
Let's compare that with what your doctor asked you to do.
goals: 아침 인슐린 종류와 실제 투여 용량을 확인한다
지시된 조정과 일치하는지 대조한다

situations.title: 항혈소판제 복용 확인
situations.tagline: I take a baby aspirin every day for my heart — should I have stopped it?
situations.brief: 아스피린 등 항혈소판제 복용 여부를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Do you take aspirin or any other blood-thinning pill?
Is that a daily baby aspirin for your heart?
When was the last time you took it?
goals: 항혈소판제 복용 여부와 목적을 확인한다
마지막 복용 시각을 기록한다

situations.title: 입실 전 혈당 측정
situations.tagline: Do you need to check my sugar again before I go back?
situations.brief: 수술실 입실 전 혈당을 측정하고 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to check your blood sugar before we go in.
You'll feel a quick little poke on your finger.
Your number looks good — let me tell you what it is.
goals: 입실 전 혈당을 측정하고 절차를 안내한다
결과 수치를 환자에게 설명한다

situations.title: 와파린 중단 브릿징
situations.tagline: I stopped my warfarin, but I've been giving myself those belly shots — is that still the plan?
situations.brief: 와파린 중단 후 헤파린 bridging을 제대로 이행했는지 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: When did you take your last warfarin dose?
Have you been giving yourself the heparin shots as planned?
When was your last injection?
goals: 와파린 중단 시점과 bridging 헤파린 이행을 확인한다
마지막 주사 시각을 기록하고 지시와 대조한다

situations.title: DOAC 중단 시점
situations.tagline: My kidneys aren't great, so when exactly was I supposed to stop that new blood thinner?
situations.brief: 신기능을 고려해 DOAC 중단 시점이 적절했는지 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Which blood thinner do you take, and when was your last dose?
Because of your kidneys, the timing matters a lot.
Let me confirm this with the anesthesia team.
goals: DOAC 종류와 마지막 복용 시각을 확인한다
신기능을 고려한 중단 적정성을 팀과 확인한다

situations.title: 메트포르민 조영 병용
situations.tagline: I take metformin — is that a problem with the dye they're using today?
situations.brief: 조영제 사용 예정 환자의 메트포르민 병용 위험을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: When did you last take your metformin?
We may hold it around the time of the contrast dye.
I'll flag this with the team before we proceed.
goals: 메트포르민 마지막 복용과 조영제 병용 여부를 확인한다
위험을 설명하고 팀에 보고한다

situations.title: 인슐린 펌프 착용
situations.tagline: I have an insulin pump on — do I keep it running during surgery?
situations.brief: 인슐린 펌프 착용 환자의 수술 중 펌프 관리 계획을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you show me where your pump is placed?
What's your current basal rate set to?
The team will decide whether to keep it running or switch over.
goals: 펌프 위치와 기저 주입률을 확인한다
수술 중 펌프 관리 계획을 팀과 조율한다

situations.title: 상시 스테로이드 복용
situations.tagline: I've been on prednisone for years — will I need a stress dose today?
situations.brief: 상시 스테로이드 복용 환자의 스트레스 용량 필요 여부를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: How long have you been taking steroids?
What's your usual daily dose?
I'll let the team know you may need a stress dose.
goals: 스테로이드 종류·용량·복용 기간을 확인한다
스트레스 용량 필요성을 팀에 전달한다

situations.title: 항혈소판 중단 심장 위험
situations.tagline: They told me to stop my heart medicine, but won't that put my heart at risk?
situations.brief: 항혈소판제 중단 시 혈전 위험과 출혈 위험의 균형을 설명하고 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: I understand you're worried about stopping your heart medicine.
The team weighs your clot risk against bleeding during surgery.
Let me confirm the plan with your cardiologist and anesthesia.
goals: 중단에 대한 환자의 불안을 확인하고 설명한다
심장 위험을 팀과 확인해 계획을 재확인한다

situations.title: 금식 중 저혈당 증상
situations.tagline: I've been fasting since midnight and now I feel shaky and sweaty.
situations.brief: 금식 중 저혈당 증상을 호소하는 환자를 사정하고 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Tell me exactly how you're feeling right now.
I'm going to check your blood sugar right away.
Stay with me — we'll treat this quickly if it's low.
goals: 저혈당 증상을 사정하고 즉시 혈당을 측정한다
필요 시 신속히 처치하고 팀에 보고한다

situations.title: 한약·보조제 출혈 위험
situations.tagline: I only take some herbal supplements — those don't really count, do they?
situations.brief: 비처방 한약·보조제의 출혈 위험 인자를 다시 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Even herbal supplements can matter before surgery.
Can you list everything you take, including vitamins and teas?
Some of these can increase bleeding, so we need to know.
goals: 복용 중인 모든 보조제·한약을 확인한다
출혈 위험이 있는 성분을 파악해 기록한다

situations.title: 약물 중단 지시 미이행
situations.tagline: Heads up — bed 4 took his full dose of apixaban this morning; the hold order wasn't followed.
situations.brief: 중단 지시가 이행되지 않은 사실을 발견해 팀에 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: The patient in bed 4 didn't hold his blood thinner as ordered.
He took a full dose about six hours ago.
I wanted to flag this before the case moves forward.
goals: 미중단 사실과 마지막 복용 시각을 정확히 파악한다
팀에 SBAR로 신속히 보고한다

situations.title: 항응고제 미중단 응급 출혈
situations.tagline: He never stopped his warfarin and now he's oozing everywhere — can we get the reversal agent ready?
situations.brief: 항응고제 미중단 환자의 출혈에 대비해 역전제를 긴급 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: He didn't hold his warfarin and he's bleeding more than expected.
Can we get vitamin K and reversal agent to the room now?
I'll draw a stat coag panel and stay on it.
goals: 미중단으로 인한 출혈 위험을 팀에 전달한다
역전제와 응급 준비를 신속히 협조한다

situations.title: 심한 고혈당·DKA 의심
situations.tagline: His sugar is over 400 and he's got ketones — I think we should hold the case.
situations.brief: DKA가 의심되는 고혈당 환자의 수술 보류를 팀과 논의하세요.
keyPhrases: His glucose is over 400 with ketones and he's breathing fast.
I'm concerned this could be DKA.
Should we hold the case and start treatment first?
goals: DKA 의심 징후를 확인하고 팀에 보고한다
수술 보류 여부를 함께 판단한다

situations.title: 저혈당 의식 저하
situations.tagline: Her sugar just came back at 38 and she's barely responding — I need help here.
situations.brief: 저혈당으로 의식이 저하된 환자에게 응급 처치를 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Her blood sugar is 38 and she's not responding well.
Can we push D50 and recheck in a few minutes?
I need another set of hands right now.
goals: 저혈당에 따른 의식 저하를 즉시 인지한다
D50 투여 등 응급 처치를 신속히 협조한다

situations.title: 이중 항혈소판 스텐트 응급
situations.tagline: He's on dual antiplatelets for a recent stent — stopping both worries me for stent thrombosis.
situations.brief: 최근 스텐트 환자의 이중 항혈소판제 중단에 따른 혈전 위험에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: He had a drug-eluting stent placed just two months ago.
Stopping both antiplatelets raises the risk of stent thrombosis.
Can we loop in cardiology before we proceed?
goals: 스텐트 시기와 이중 항혈소판 중단 위험을 파악한다
심장내과와 협의해 계획을 조정한다

situations.title: 와파린 INR 위험 상승
situations.tagline: Her INR came back at 4.8 — that's way too high for surgery; I'm calling it up now.
situations.brief: 위험 수준으로 상승한 INR을 긴급히 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: Her INR just resulted at 4.8.
That's too high to proceed safely today.
I'm reporting this to anesthesia and the surgeon now.
goals: 위험 수준의 INR을 신속히 인지한다
팀에 보고하고 수술 지연 여부를 논의한다

situations.title: 인슐린 펌프 오작동 고혈당
situations.tagline: My pump's been alarming all morning and now my sugar reading is really high.
situations.brief: 인슐린 펌프 오작동으로 고혈당이 발생한 환자에게 긴급히 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's look at your pump and your last blood sugar together.
I'm going to recheck your sugar and tell the team right away.
We'll manage this — try not to worry.
goals: 펌프 오작동과 고혈당 상태를 확인한다
즉시 혈당을 재측정하고 팀에 보고한다
